steps.title: Pick a profile
steps.note: Explorer for browsing, Edition for listing and editor side by side. Or compose your own: four zones, one panel each, saved and switchable from the top bar.

steps.title: Open the file, do not just find it
steps.note: CodeMirror with syntax highlighting, Markdown preview, inline images, archives browsed in place, spreadsheets with a live filter. Files over a megabyte load in chunks.

steps.title: Act on what you selected
steps.note: The right-click menu adapts: several images become a PDF, CSVs merge, a messy folder sorts itself by type or date, undoable. Media tools open a docked editing HUD.

steps.title: Or just say it
steps.note: Ctrl+K searches files across the disk, actions and places at once. In the built-in terminal, claude drives the window through a local MCP server on a Unix socket.
